chapters.title: CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies and secrets

topics.title: CI/CD pipeline stages: build, test and zero-downtime design
paraphrases: What the build and test stages of a CI/CD pipeline do and how to design a pipeline that deploys without downtime.

concepts.learning_objective: What the build and test stages of a CI/CD pipeline do and how to design a pipeline that deploys without downtime.

topics.title: Deployment strategies: blue-green, canary and rolling
paraphrases: How blue-green, canary and rolling deployments release a new version and limit risk and downtime.

concepts.learning_objective: How blue-green, canary and rolling deployments release a new version and limit risk and downtime.

topics.title: Secrets management in CI/CD and Kubernetes
paraphrases: Keeping passwords, keys and tokens out of code by using a secrets manager such as Vault or Kubernetes Secrets.

concepts.learning_objective: Keeping passwords, keys and tokens out of code by using a secrets manager such as Vault or Kubernetes Secrets.

topics.title: Git branching strategies: GitFlow and trunk-based development
paraphrases: How GitFlow and trunk-based development organise feature, release and main branches and the trade-offs of long-lived branches.

concepts.learning_objective: How GitFlow and trunk-based development organise feature, release and main branches and the trade-offs of long-lived branches.

topics.title: GitOps principles and reconciliation
paraphrases: Using a Git repository as the source of truth for desired state and automatically reconciling the cluster to match it.

concepts.learning_objective: Using a Git repository as the source of truth for desired state and automatically reconciling the cluster to match it.

chapters.title: Infrastructure as Code and configuration management

topics.title: Infrastructure as Code fundamentals and configuration drift
paraphrases: Why infrastructure is defined and versioned as code, and how that avoids the configuration drift of manual setups.

concepts.learning_objective: Why infrastructure is defined and versioned as code, and how that avoids the configuration drift of manual setups.

topics.title: Ansible configuration management and idempotency
paraphrases: Ansible as an infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tool and why its playbooks are idempotent.

concepts.learning_objective: Ansible as an infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tool and why its playbooks are idempotent.

concepts.learning_objective: How Docker containers differ from virtual machines in kernel sharing, isolation, startup time and resource use, and when to pick each.
